fact: The progress report submitted on 29 November 2024 for GPE grant GPE0000813 (US$32,279,000, grant agent CAMFED, 1 September 2023 to 31 August 2026) says a standard national early warning system was piloted through the System Transformation Grant by UNICEF and partners, and that its scaling through the Girls' Education Accelerator, to 545 target schools by the end of the project, was on hold in Year 1 pending verification by ECOZI and approval by MoPSE and the Education Coordination Group.
title: System Transformation Grant Annual Progress Report Template for Projects: Zimbabwe - STG + GEA
